definitions.explanation: The leisure activity of going to stores, malls, or browsing online to buy clothing, accessories, gifts, and similar items. Carries a more recreational nuance than the everyday {買|か}い{物|もの}.

examples.japanese: ショッピング⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ショッピング⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: I enjoyed shopping with my friends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧ショッピングモール⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: On the weekend, my family went out to a large shopping mall.

notes:
From English 'shopping'. Often appears in compounds for retail facilities. Carries a recreational, browsing nuance — for routine errands (groceries, household items), ⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧ is more natural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ショッピング⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go shopping
- ショッピング⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to shop; to go shopping
- ショッピングモール: shopping mall
- ショッピングセンター: shopping center
- ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧ショッピング: online shopping

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧: shopping; errands — more everyday, includes groceries and necessities
- ウィンドウショッピング: window shopping — browsing without buying
